text.description_html:
Omnia AL599 Simple Aluminum Cabinet Hardware

Available in a 5 inch length and a 7-7/8 inch length, this Omnia Standard Aluminum Handle features a a beautiful, simple design that will enhance the look of any cabinet door or drawer. It has a aluminum (US28) finish so that it is just as pleasing to the eye as it is comfortable to the hand.

Omnia had been known for quality for more than 40 years, so you can be assured that this standard cabinet pull will endure through the lifetime of your home while remaining beautiful.

Available in 2 Sizes:

  • OMN-AL599/128 - Length: 5", Projection: 5/8"
  • OMN-AL599/200 - Length: 7-7/8", Projection: 5/8"
